query: Migrate all pages in the ClassicPages library to modern pages.
expected_behavior: Starts with a dry run of scripts/spo-convert-pages-bulk.ps1 -SourceLibrary "ClassicPages", spawning no subprocesses and making no writes
Recommends trying a single page with -PageName before the full run
Requires -Execute -ConfirmToken CONVERT-SPO-PAGES-BULK for real writes and leaves running it to the user

query: The run stopped after 40 pages. How do I carry on?
expected_behavior: Uses -ResumeFromManifest so pages already recorded as Succeeded are skipped
Explains each page's result was appended to -ManifestPath as the run progressed
Keeps the throttle delay (-ThrottleDelaySeconds, default 2) in mind for SharePoint Online rate limits

query: Does the bulk run also fix the links in the converted pages?
expected_behavior: Says it does not rewrite embedded links, because same-site conversion does not do that
Points to sharepoint-site-migration for a separate pass
Notes validation runs automatically afterwards unless -SkipValidation is set, and the run exits non-zero if any page fails
